Lipid Classification System

The LIPID MAPS® Lipid Classification System is comprised of eight lipid categories, each with its own subclassification hierarchy. All lipids in the LIPID MAPS® Structure Database (LMSD) have been classified using this system and have been assigned a unique LIPID MAPS® ID (LM_ID).

  • Classification Updates (updated on February 20th, 2024)
